Alex — thanks again for the quick intro today. To make the most of the 45–60 minute compact demo we discussed, we want to make sure the right sponsor-level presence is confirmed (VP / CIO). A few asks and proposals to align schedules: 

1) Two candidate windows (ET):
   - Option A: Wed Jul 14, 2027 1:00–1:45 PM ET (noon PT)
   - Option B: Thu Jul 15, 2027 4:00–4:45 PM ET (late afternoon for us, early evening for EMEA folks)

2) Recording: is the team OK with a recording for internal review / CS playbook? We can stop recording for execs or turn off post-demo if preferred.

3) Backup coverage: If your CIO can’t attend, would the VP of Engineering or Head of Infrastructure be an acceptable fallback? We’ll plan for a quick 10‑minute sponsor intro and then a 30‑35 minute walkthrough focused on performance and integration.

Attached: compact-demo-agenda.pdf (high level);
Pinging Ben and Karthik to offer to cover any deep-ops or contract questions during the session.
